Planning for round 326 → 327 is finished. The decision is **CONTINUE**. Attempt 1 had written everything and stopped during the final advisor check. This attempt picked up from its checkpoint, ran that check, and filled in the empty §8 of `b-round-326.md`. Nothing was redone, and the store tree is still clean on `234ccdd`. The advisor was available and was used.

**Rounds 325 and 326 closed from evidence.** C's round 326 passed with `browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true. Gate 326 shows `published`, so its commit `234ccdd` is the next baseline.
- PERF-DRAG-PREVIEW stage a and GATE325-IM24-WALLCLOCK are now done.
- C-R326-01 (Low) came from my own task spec: I asked the browser to check something an earlier round had ruled jsdom-only. It goes to `deferred_low_polish`, under SYS-CLOCK-DETERMINISM.
- C's two info notes became a Live measurement request (LIVE-MEAS-MARKER-STEP-PLAYING, for root to measure in Live) and an unscheduled signal (SIG-R326-END-STOP-STATUS).

**Round 327: PERF-DRAG-PREVIEW stage b, the audio fade-handle drag.**
- **Cause:** at HEAD a fade drag re-renders 103.25 components per pointer move. Each move writes both the arrangement history and the provider's status text.
- **Change:**
  - the fade geometry goes through `previewClipGeometry`;
  - the per-move fade text moves into a new status-preview store, drawn by a small footer component;
  - `setStatus` picks up any pending preview before a normal write, so `aria-live` doesn't announce the same text twice;
  - six places that compare the status text read the displayed text instead;
  - video fades are unchanged until stage c.
- **My trial build:** 21.633 components per move (max 22), no graph restarts, and the full suite passed 3555/3555. Seven test mutants and one performance mutant all failed as they should.
- **Budgets:** five fade rows become hard limits (≤ 24 per move and max, restarts = 0).
- **Target:** the item's target of ≤ 15 per move stays. Fade still misses it, so the rest of the work is in stage c.
- **Ownership:** A may edit 11 named files. Protected auth files and `package.json` are excluded.
- **C checks in the browser at both viewports, against HEAD:** the status text at each step, cancel, end-stop, playback, the WAV export hash and the video fade. C also runs the mutants and the performance measurement alone.

**Next:**
- **Round 328:** a REGRESSION round if it is planned on or after 2026-11-05 (the last one was 2026-11-02, round 301). Otherwise PERF-DRAG-PREVIEW stage c.
- **Architecture:** round 327 adds a fourth per-provider store to `ArrangementContext.tsx`. I added a note to the open frontend-architect checkpoint request (D-29z915) without opening a new one. It doesn't block round 327.
- **Remaining scope:** 34 IDs are listed in `b-next.json`, from PERF-9…15, STEM-LANES and SYS-1…3 through the STORE stages and phase 2. None is blocked by anything external.
